The main takeaway from our work is that
, with the right model architecture and training data, multimodal information can be used to improve performance on a task that has been traditionally considered to be purely text-based.
the proposed modality attention is a generic and effective mechanism to incorporate multiple modalities for various tasks, especially when the provided modalities are noisy or incomplete.
